_doc: Enemy tuning (docs/ENEMIES.md). Tier speeds in m/s; each spawn gets Â±jitter.

variants_by_map._doc: Outfit kits per map (MZ, T-041; kits in anim.json). The retired laborer share is the villager kit on Map 0 and the technician kit on Map 1; the Map 1 Intake laborers are story only.

dread._doc: T-232 (docs/BOSS_REWORK.md 2.4): the kit's block for the Foreman (gravelight/enemies/foreman.gd makes its own BossFx). Iron hits (sparks, boss_hit_iron; the core flashes violet), boss_stomp footfalls with a view shake.

arrival._doc: T-232: the rock burst. Dust and chips every dust_every s through the 4 s tell; at the burst the lights within light_radius drop to light_drop and gutter, back after light_back_s.

enrage_lights._doc: T-232: ENRAGED puts the gallery lamps within radius of him down to level and keeps them out; when he has walked follow_m from where they went out the dark is re-captured round him (he is the light: his core and headlamp burn brighter).

vent._doc: T-232: Core Vent, the ENRAGED move. He plants the drill: windup s of the core flaring (the core takes core_mult the whole time), then a Nachtglas burst: damage + whip_slow for slow_seconds + a dread punch on every player within radius m. Counter: back off past radius, or shoot the core while it flares.

squad._doc: T-232: the squad rules. A hurt player (under hurt_fraction of max HP, within hurt_range, in his sight) is his target while he stalks and hears the shift cadence every hurt_shout_every s (the dread layer reads him looking at them). A lone player gets the chain whip from any side (alone_whip_any_side), not only from behind.

bordschuetze._doc: Map 4 Act II (UPDATE 07, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md 4.5): the Kranich's phantom gunners in flight gear climb in over the blister rims and through open breaches. Not a pooled type of its own: the FlightController spawns Gängers with this spec (kit, tier, health_mult, no barricade to tear) at the climb entries (gravelight/world/map04/flight_controller.gd), on Druckabfall rounds in place of the window spawns.

suited._doc: Map 4 Act IV (UPDATE 07, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md 6.9, T-112): Gängers in the Provider's pressure suits (stencilled PERPETUAL). x1.4 health, the visor is the weak point (head_mult; a visor hit cracks it: in vacuum they die visor_death_seconds later even if the shot didn't kill, in pressure it is just the headshot). They walk and jog, never leap, never crawl. vacuum_only: the director and the Solar Flare spawn them where there is no air, nowhere else.

shield_cell._doc: Map 4 Act IV (T-113): the Account Manager's three shield-cells, violet spheres that orbit her in COLLECTIONS (gravelight/enemies/map04/shield_cell.gd, a Zombie so every weapon and the Lodestone's lift / fling work on them). health is their own (not the round's); they regenerate every regen_seconds; one flung or carried into the vacuum shaft is gone for good. No Scrip, no crawl, no stagger.

burrower._doc: Map 4 Act III (UPDATE 07, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md 5.5): the range's construction crews under the salt. Not a pooled type: Gangers rising at the lakebed's burrow points are tagged by the GroomController (map04c.json groom.burrower), the staged rise is the tell.

canary._doc: Map 4 Act III: the program's test subjects in hazmat suits with glass hoods. Tagged Gangers (groom.canary): health x1.3, torso x1.5, a head kill releases the hood gas (GasCloud). Body shots are the clean kill.

jumpjockey._doc: Map 4 Act III (and the Moon): test pilots with the program's jump rigs. Tagged Gangers (groom.jumpjockey): health x1.2, a leap from a launch point; shot in the air they fall and die.

backorder._doc: Map 4 Act III (and the Moon): Darkmatter's retention construct, phased through walls, solid to attack. Tagged Gangers (groom.backorder), max 2, after the relay coil is taken.

kielholer._doc: Map 2 (UPDATE 10 C2, T-153): the drowned, U-1047's ratings and the harbour's dead, rising at the pier edges while the GameState flag flooded is on (KielholerController tags Ganger spawns at the Surface_* points and a share of the Pen Hall's). A grabber: within grab_range of a player it takes hold and pulls toward the nearest water edge at pull_mps (the player wades at grab_status); it lets go to the held player's melee, to arm_break_damage on its arm_grab hitbox from anyone, to team_break_damage from teammates anywhere (half weight off the arm), or after max_hold; nobody is re-grabbed for regrab_lock. Held: hold_dps, edge_dps within edge_m of the edge (never an instant kill). Kit drowned (the sailor cut, waterlogged).

kielholer_diver._doc: Map 2 (UPDATE 10 C2, T-153): a Kielholer in the harbour salvage crew's diving dress (kit drowned_diver). The brass helmet soaks hits (helmet_mult on the helmet_glass hitbox and on the head) until helmet_break_fraction of its max HP has gone into the helmet; then the glass breaks and the violet glow behind it (a Marke in the helmet, U09 C1; the hand mark is cleared) takes glow_mult. Grabs like the Kielholer.

soviet_risen._doc: UPDATE 11 section 6 (T-192): the Soviet risen, the Returned (the Red Army's own dead from the October 1944 FOURTH DAY release, walking west): a set of Ganger skins on the existing rig and AI (anim.json kits soviet / soviet_tunic / soviet_burial), no new behaviour, no Marke (never marked, CANON 2.2): their weak point is the wound that killed them (ZombieBody.WOUND_SITES, the same hitbox, damage_mult and scrip_bonus as the Marke). ZombieDirector swaps a plain Ganger spawn's kit for one of `kits` with probability `share` on the maps listed, from `from_round`, only at spawns at or above `min_y` (Kaltenbrunn: the surface at y 0, never the depths at -12 / -18). Map 0's background column on the landscape is map00_ambience.json risen_column (presentation only).

hard_truth._doc: UPDATE 11 section 6 (T-192): the fourth-day rule, Hard Truth (gravelight/world/hard_truth.gd). Settings > Gameplay hard_truth: auto (on unless Classic Rules), on, off; online the host's setting decides. When a squad member (a human or a bot, never a companion: Jakub and the map companions are out cold, not dead) bleeds out, their body lies where they fell as a dormant zombie (no hitboxes, no damage, no collision) and gets up after rise_delay_s of round time (a body that bled out in the break waits for the round), over getup_s. It is a normal pooled, networked zombie outside the round queue (RoundManager.take_extra_spawn: the round cannot end while it stands), in that survivor's own risen body (PeopleBodies), unmarked. Putting it down drops their death crate where it falls: a free ammunition crate (FallenCrate, the relief squads' SquadCrate) good for crate_uses refills, gone after crate_seconds. The respawn rules do not change.

marke._doc: UPDATE 09 section 1 (T-137, docs/U09_CONTRACTS.md C1): the Marke, Darkmatter's chip under the skin, the weak point every Ganger shows (never a boss, never the Backorder construct; the Suited keep it on the hand). Site picked per zombie from its net_id (hand_chance of a right-hand mark, else the forehead) so co-op puppets match the host. hitbox_m: the cube on bone RightHand / the front of Head, limb "marke". A Marke hit does damage_mult x the damage and then counts as a hit on the host limb (arms / head). A kill from a Marke hit pays scrip_bonus through Economy.award (Double Scrip applies; nothing in Classic Rules) and emits GLBus.marke_kill. glow_min..glow_max: the glint's emission with the map hum (gl_hum), brighter with gl_round_k.

roam._doc: Open ground (T-080, Map 0's GROUNDS round the inn; ZoneVolume.roam). A zombie on open ground on its way to a window (or tearing it) goes for a player standing on the open ground within aggro_m whom it can walk to (no shut door or window on the way); one chasing someone it can't walk to makes for the best reachable window in an open zone instead (of the window_tries nearest). recheck_s: how often each zombie looks again (jittered +-20%). reach_m: how close the navmesh path must end to the goal.

wading._doc: Map 2: standing in the flooded pump deck at high tide (tide_controller.gd refreshes it every tick).

boss_grab._doc: HB1: held by a homage boss's grab (the Reach's Long Reach, Alix's Holding Hand); the boss drags the player. Refreshed every tick while held.

held_hand._doc: HB1: Alix's Holding Hand (the vignette + the audio low-pass of the status FX).

splinters._doc: HB1: the Hammer's Overhead Split floor zone.

ballast._doc: Map 2: carrying a lead coffin (the Ballast mechanic, deferred; data only).

vacuum._doc: Map 4 Act IV (T-112): standing in a zone with no air (ZoneVolume.vacuum) away from an AirPost; Player._update_air refreshes it every tick while the AIR gauge runs down. No slow: the suit mix and the visor rim are the HUD's.

gas_slow._doc: Map 4 Act III: inside a Canary's hood gas (gravelight/world/map04/gas_cloud.gd).

kielholer_grab._doc: Map 2 (T-153): held by a Kielholer (or DER KIELHOLER) and dragged toward the water; refreshed every tick while held.

emerge._doc: The rise from the ground (T-085, enemies/zombie_emerge.gd). variants: clip length in seconds at round multiplier 1, pick weight, and the normalized stage times the clip's keys sit on and the gameplay fires off (hitboxes enable at head_out; particles and sounds per stage). tier_weight_mult biases the pick per speed tier (runners and sprinters lunge out, shamblers claw). round_scale: the multiplier on every ground rise ramps from start at start_round to end at end_round (faster later). surface_by_map / surface_classes: the mound, spray and sound class (snow / earth / stone) from the floor under the spawn (a ZombieSpawn meta 'surface' overrides). death_sink_speed: a zombie killed mid-rise slides back into the ground at this multiple of its rise speed.

fast._doc: A lunge out of the ground: both hands almost together, one heave, a stagger-lunge to standing.

standard._doc: The dig-out: one hand claws, the second, the head and shoulders heave out twisting, an elbow plant, a knee, a lurch up with a stagger step.

slow._doc: A long clawing rise: it hangs at the rim (pause), shudders, and tears free with a second heave.

roll._doc: Face first: it drags itself out flat onto its belly, rolls onto its side, comes up on a knee at the rim.

crawler._doc: Crawlers (spec crawler: true, or legs lost mid-rise): elbows planted, they drag out onto their belly and stay down. Never rolled for walkers (weight 0).

effects._doc: Mound: the bulge radius / height (m) before the crust breaks; hole: the dark broken ring. dig_every: seconds between claw crunches while a hand rakes. spray: particle counts.

leap_hop._doc: The low-g hop (Map 4 Act IV, T-112): below max_gravity_scale every pressurized Gänger (kinds with leap_hop true or unset) that has a clear line to its target between range_min and range_max m crouches telegraph_seconds and leaps a ballistic arc of apex_height m at the target, lands with a short stagger, and waits cooldown_seconds before the next. Never in vacuum (the Suited never leap), never crawlers.
